title: Warm Double Fried Saudi Arabian Chicken Noodles
description: A flavorful and satisfying Saudi Arabian dish featuring double fried chicken, served with fluffy rice noodles and a blend of umami spices, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 cup of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together flour, cornstarch, spices, salt, and pepper.
Dredge the chicken pieces in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Fry the chicken in the hot oil for 5 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Increase the oil temperature to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Fry the chicken again for an additional 5 minutes, until golden brown and crispy.
Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat 1 cup of chicken broth over medium heat.
Add the cooked noodles to the chicken broth and stir to combine.
To serve, place the noodles in a bowl, top with double fried chicken, and sprinkle with spices.
